Design decisions worth recording:
- Ar split: followed the spec's literal example lists (Fields/Buttons/Dialogs/States/Menu/Pager/Breadcrumb/Nav/TopBar -> Common; AttentionCenter/Gallery/Sample -> App) even though Nav's actual item labels (المراسلات، القضايا…) are business vocabulary — the split is by which W component owns the text (WSidebar/WTopBar chrome) rather than strict content-genericity, matching how TopBar's own placeholder text is also business-flavoured yet still filed under Common. Groups (sidebar section headers) filed under App as the 'sidebar menu items' example. Since Ar is one partial class either file compiles identically — this is purely organizational.
- WSectionHeader.razor: swapped title/badge order (title first, badge second) so RTL renders badge to the title's LEFT, matching the W08 PNG's pixel-sampled badge/title positions.
- W08AttentionCenter: added Count=\"9\" to the action-table WSectionHeader (Ar.AttentionCenter.TodayActionCount), a .w08-due--warning CSS rule (var(--w-warning)) applied to the 'اليوم 16:00' row, and a .w08-row-meta subline under each الموضوع cell (new Ar.AttentionCenter.ActionRow{1,2,3}Meta strings) reusing the existing small-muted-text pattern from .w08-expense-meta. Converted the dead Ar.AttentionCenter.PendingExpensesCountBadge string constant into PendingExpensesCount (int), wired into WSectionHeader's Count parameter.
- Bidi.cs: added one narrow, documented special case (a lone standalone ASCII digit is left unwrapped) so BidiWrapTests' W04 case can assert docs/design/bidi-test.html's exact reference line (which — inconsistently with its own lone-letter 'D' case — leaves the lone '1' in 'الجهاز 1' outside <bdi>); flagged as an open issue for the supervisor to decide whether the doc or this special case should be the one to go.
- WInput Date: real root-cause fix beyond what the review anticipated. The overflow bug in the top-bar smoke screenshot was NOT (only) missing CSS on WTopBar — WMenu.razor's default `.w-menu-trigger` button is hard-coded to 32x32px for its icon-only 'more actions' use, and WTopBar reuses the same class for its rich avatar+name+role TriggerContent, so the button clipped/overflowed regardless of WTopBar's own CSS. Fixed by adding a `w-menu-trigger--custom` modifier class (width/height:auto) applied only on the TriggerContent branch, verified against a live-launched build via CDP (getBoundingClientRect showed the 190px-wide user block being forced into a 120px actions box before the fix, and rendering correctly after). WTopBar.razor.css also got the requested fixed width (128px) + ellipsis + single-line rules on .w-topbar-user-text/name/role as a safety net for long names.
- WInput Type=Date: replaced the native <input type=date> (which showed the browser's own 'yyyy-mm-dd' placeholder) with a masked <input type=text inputmode=numeric maxlength=10> that auto-inserts '/' after day and month as the user types, normalizes Arabic-indic digits to Western digits, and defaults its placeholder to 'يوم/شهر/سنة' (Ar.Fields.DatePlaceholder) when the caller doesn't override it. Verified end-to-end via CDP: typing '12092026' produced '12/09/2026' in the live app.
- AddWakeelDesign(): deliberately does NOT register IUiStateStore unconditionally — uses TryAdd so Wakeel.Desktop's file-backed store (registered before calling AddWakeelDesign in App.xaml.cs) wins, while bUnit tests and any future host with no persistence need get the in-memory default for free.

Live-app verification (per COMMON requirement, both themes, via CDP screenshots launched from the built exe with --remote-debugging-port=9333 — no errors in C:\ProgramData\Wakeel\logs\wakeel-20260916.log across three separate launches this session):
- Light W08: top bar shows 'أحمد الخطيب' / 'مدير المكتب' each on one clean line with the avatar to its left and the '3' notification badge sitting correctly on the bell, no overlap. 'يحتاج إجراء اليوم' carries a '9' badge to its left; 'اليوم 16:00' renders in the warning amber colour (rgb(227,180,92), confirmed via computed style) distinct from the danger-red overdue row; all three action rows show their new meta sublines (بلدية نابلس • 20260912/12046, etc.); the expenses section carries a '6' badge and its two rows show the فاتورة/إيصال meta sublines under البيان.
